eligibility.evidence: Abstract, Sec 3: SenseMath is a new programmatically generated benchmark of 4,800 items (8 shortcut categories, 4 digit scales). Number sense is cited from mathematics education (McIntosh et al., 2005), but no human cognitive-experimental task or human data is administered or modelled; no human comparison. A reviewer could count it as numerical cognition.

A.title: SenseMath: Do LLMs Have Number Sense? Evaluating Shortcut Use, Judgment, and Generation

G.notes: Excluded as benchmark-only; borderline because the framing is behavioural number sense (shortcut use, applicability judgment, generation) on five models (GPT-4o-mini, GPT-4.1-mini, Qwen3-30B, Qwen3-8B, Llama-3.1-8B), greedy decoding, no human data. Code and data link given in the abstract.
